title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode3 Countdown Party!

meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! Won't it be fun, if it's just us?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Forget about me joining. I told you yesterday that I don't want to go out.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh... You won't have to!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's simple! Let's do it in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! We can meet up without having to go outside and we'll get to party together with Miku!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But there's nothing there.
It's not really a party place...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's why we'll bring snacks and stuff!
I can take care of organizing it all so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You'll take care of everything?
Then maybe I can drop by and...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yeah. It'll be good to see Miku.
I haven't talked to her in a while.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll be busy on New Year's Day since we'll be visiting relatives, but if it's just tonight, I can do it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll let you know on Nightcord when everything's ready, and then we can move over to SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But...
Maybe that's for the best...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope they're all doing well...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Cheer up, Miku.
We're here to party tonight!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! Miku, do you want to join our New Year's Eve Countdown Party?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a party celebrating the end of the year and the start of a new one. It was Mizuki's idea.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It may get a bit rowdy, but is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What did you bring, Mizuki?
That's a lot of bags...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Party snacks! I might've gone a bit overboard but we should be all set!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I brought something too, actually.
Here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oooh, juice from a department store!
Wait, it's from that really famous place!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was an end-of-the-year gift from one of my parents' friends. I have no idea how much it's worth...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We got so many gifts that no one will miss it. We can all try it together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I brought snacks too...
Roast chicken flavor chips.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, the limited edition Christmas flavor?!
I wanted to try them too...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here are some disposable plates, cups and napkins.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You brought stuff for the party too?!
Hey, these napkins look really fancy!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom bought them a while ago but didn't use them in the end. I thought they might come in handy today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, they sure will!
Thanks, guys!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, mind if I arrange these snacks on the plates Mafuyu brought?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: With all these snacks laid out, it really does feel like a party's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? We've got the snacks I brought, Kanade's chips and Ena's fancy juice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu's napkins even add a touch of class to our awesome party...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That might be a little much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But... This is nice every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, it's almost time to start the countdown!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I've never done anything like this before.
I'm getting this warm and fuzzy feeling...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then let's get this show on the road! Get ready to count down together! You too, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Good! So, on my cue...
Five! Four! Three! Two! One!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This used to be such a lonely place that only Mafuyu visited sometimes, but now it's much livelier thanks to everyone here.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Anything can happen from here on out...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's have a wonderful year, everyone.
